units.source_text: 女人也总算放松了下来，舌头周围也变得轻松了，

en.t: The woman finally relaxed too, and even the area around her tongue seemed to loosen up,

units.source_text: “我们呐，觉得要出汗的时候，就尽量赤膊不穿衣服……

en.t: You see, when we feel like we're going to sweat, we try to go bare-skinned and not wear clothes as much as possible...

units.source_text: 反正就这副模样了，也不在乎别人怎么瞧……”

en.t: Anyway, looking like this already, we don't care how other people see us...
